description: Bucket-brigade delay: the signal is clocked through an analogue-style delay line whose clock rate you set, with feedback, a modulation oscillator and a noise floor of its own

params.text: Sets the clock rate of the delay line in hertz, up to 20000Hz; a faster clock is a shorter delay
Sets the level of the signal going into the delay line
Sets how much of the output is fed back into the delay line; the feedback is soft-limited at 0.3 so it cannot run away
Crossfades the output between the dry signal and the delayed one
Each press latches this switch on or off, choosing between two ways of clocking the bucket-brigade line
Sets how far the modulation oscillator moves the clock rate, up to 6000Hz either way
Sets the speed of the modulation oscillator, up to 15 times a second

inputs.text: Shifts the clock rate of the delay line, 1V moving it by 600Hz
The audio fed into the delay line, scaled by the input knob

outputs.text: The dry and delayed signals mixed according to the mix knob

notes: none of the controls is lettered on the panel; what each one does is in this entry and in the tooltips.

inputs.0:
continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage subtracts from the knob.
inputs.1:
bipolar · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V.
